original_definition.name: the policy path is fixed per platform and a missing file means no policy

previous_coverage_row.name: the policy path is fixed per platform and a missing file means no policy

evidence.scope: Only the exact mapped native assertions; no actual system policy/Keychain interaction, cross-platform or installed-artifact qualification is implied.

remaining_assertions: The fixed Linux path is present behind native platform selection but has not yet been executed in the retained evidence for this definition; both platform branches are required.

per_assertion.native_predicate: On actual macOS 15 Intel CI, the compiled target branch asserts default_policy_path() equals /Library/Application Support/claude-autorouter/policy.json.
On actual Linux x86_64 CI, the compiled target branch asserts default_policy_path() equals /etc/claude-autorouter/policy.json.
The same named native test constructs a missing isolated policy path and asserts load_policy_at(&path, trusted_uid).unwrap().is_none() on both actual CI targets.

native_API_review.preserved: The fixed policy path is selected for each supported host OS, and an absent isolated policy is optional. The product load_policy() delegates to the same default path and load_policy_at implementation with root trust.
native_API_review.migration: JavaScript defaultPolicyPath(platform) accepts a runtime platform argument and returns a string; Rust default_policy_path() selects at compile time and returns Path. The source undefined result of loadPolicy on a missing injected path maps to Rust Option::None from load_policy_at. Both actual OS branches execute in separate CI jobs; no fake cross-platform call is claimed.
native_API_review.review: Accepted for these three original assertions only. Isolated missing-path behavior is proven; no read or write of privileged system policy paths is claimed.

scope: Only original policy#1. The old partial mapping remains historical. This mapping neither approves real system-policy deployment nor whole-area/platform/release/performance gates.
